calculation_steps: Each of four tetrahedral faces splits into three equal-area triangles, coned to centroid: 12 equal-volume source cells, standard-coordinate volume 1/72.
Target cube face diagonal triangles coned to center: 12 equal-volume cells, coordinate volume 1/12.
Coordinate determinant ratio 6, physical determinant 6 b^3/(a^3/sqrt2)=1.
Abstract labeled simplex map commutes with boundary; exact oriented cell sum has 12 external triangles and zero boundary of boundary.
All 24 S4 source vertex permutations have a unique cube isometry preserving E; complements and center transform consistently, hence affine equivariance over cells.
Area source subtriangle sqrt3*a^2/12 vs target b^2/2 gives uniform induced sigma_c/sigma_t=sqrt3*a^2/(6b^2)=3^(1/6).

result.exact_expression: Jphysical=1 per cell; |matching S4 actions|=24; sigma_c/sigma_t=3^(1/6) uniform
